title: 英文求职面试
subtitle_en: Thanks for having me. I have eight years of experience.
goal_text: 能用英语做完一段自我介绍，并接住面试官的追问。
brief_cn: 面试最怕一开口就绕。这一课给你四句骨架：经验加团队、优势加一个例子、离开的正向理由、最后反过来问面试官一个问题。每句都不长，但都撑得住追问。

vocab.example_en: I practiced a short answer for my interview.
I have eight years of experience.
My biggest strength is solving problems quickly.
I lead a team of five people.
I want to leave my current company.
I am looking for a role with a bigger team.
I would like to ask about the team.
I want more growth in this role.

briefing.cn_prompt: 跟我读这句面试开场白。
briefing.ref_text: Thank you for having me today.
briefing.translation_cn: 感谢您今天给我这个机会。
briefing.accept_notes: having me 连读，today 收尾降调，别上扬。

briefing.cn_prompt: 跟我读这句自我介绍主句。
briefing.ref_text: I have eight years of experience and I lead a small team.
briefing.translation_cn: 我有八年经验，并带一个小团队。
briefing.accept_notes: experience 三个音节读满，team 不吞。

briefing.cn_prompt: 听一遍，用自己的话说清经验、团队和优势。
briefing.ref_text: I have eight years of experience. I lead a team of five. My biggest strength is solving problems quickly.
briefing.translation_cn: 我有八年经验。我带一个五人团队。我最大的优势是快速解决问题。
briefing.reference_answer: I have eight years of experience. I lead a team of five. My strength is solving problems quickly.
briefing.accept_notes: 经验、团队人数、优势三个信息点说到即通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：解释你为什么想离开。
briefing.ref_text: 我离开现在的公司是因为想要更多成长。
briefing.reference_answer: I am leaving because I want more growth.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 leaving 或 leave，并提到 growth 即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：轮到你提问时。
briefing.ref_text: 我想问一下团队的情况。
briefing.reference_answer: I would like to ask about the team.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 would like to ask 和 team 即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 用 role 说一句：你想找什么样的位置。
briefing.reference_answer: I am looking for a role with a bigger team.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 role 并表达想要的职位方向即算通过。

mission.persona_cn: 外企面试官，HR 总监，问题一个接一个
mission.user_role_cn: 来面试的候选人，一位带团队的管理者
mission.context_cn: 一轮英文职位面试。面试官先要自我介绍，接着会追问团队、优势和例子，然后问离职原因，最后把提问权交给你。
mission.opening_a: Thanks for coming. Could you start with a short introduction?
mission.opening_a_cn: 谢谢你来。先做个简短的自我介绍吧。

exchanges.a: Thanks for coming. Could you start with a short introduction?
exchanges.b: Thanks for having me. I have eight years of experience.
exchanges.a_cn: 谢谢你来。先做个简短的自我介绍吧。
exchanges.b_cn: 谢谢邀请。我有八年经验。

exchanges.a: Can you tell me about your team?
exchanges.b: I lead a team of five people.
My biggest strength is solving problems quickly.
exchanges.b_cn: 我最大的优势是快速解决问题。

exchanges.b: Last month, I fixed a delivery problem in two days.
exchanges.b_cn: 上个月我两天内解决了一个交付问题。

exchanges.a: Why do you want to leave your current company?
exchanges.b: I want more growth and a bigger role.
exchanges.a_cn: 你为什么想离开现在的公司？
exchanges.b_cn: 我想要更多成长和一个更大的职位。

exchanges.a: What kind of role are you looking for?
exchanges.b: I am looking for a role with a bigger team.
exchanges.b_cn: 我想找一个团队更大的位置。

exchanges.a: Do you have any questions for me before we finish?
exchanges.b: Yes. I would like to ask about the team.
exchanges.a_cn: 结束前你有什么想问我的吗？
exchanges.b_cn: 有。我想了解一下团队情况。

tasks.desc_cn: 用两到三句话介绍自己的经验和团队。
tasks.hint_en: I have eight years of experience and I lead a small team.

tasks.desc_cn: 说明自己的最大优势并给出一个简单例子。
tasks.hint_en: My biggest strength is solving problems quickly, for example last month.
tasks.hint_cn: 说出优势，再用上个月举例。

tasks.desc_cn: 用积极原因解释为什么离开现在的公司。
tasks.hint_en: I want more growth and a bigger role.
tasks.hint_cn: 强调成长，不抱怨现公司。

tasks.desc_cn: 向面试官提出一个关于职位或团队的问题。
tasks.hint_en: I would like to ask about the team.
